info.name: FemoraAI API
info.description: API documentation generated from the currently mounted FemoraAI backend routes. Protected requests use the collection token variable; authenticate with Login or Register first.

request.description:
Checks that the backend API is running.

Authentication: Not required.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ "success": true, "message": "FemoraAI Backend API is running" }`.

Checks backend service health.

Authentication: Not required.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ "success": true, "message": "Server is healthy" }`.

Creates a user account and returns a JWT.

Authentication: Not required.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: `name`, valid `email`, and `password` (at least 6 characters) are required.
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (201): `{ success, message, token, user: { id, name, email, createdAt } }`.
Errors: 400 for missing/invalid fields or a short password; 409 if the email already exists; 500 for a server error. The returned token can authorize protected requests.

Authenticates an existing user. On a successful 200 response, the test script saves the root-level `token` field into the collection variable `token`.

Authentication: Not required.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: `email` and `password` are required.
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (200): `{ success, message, token, user: { id, name, email, createdAt } }`.
Errors: 400 if email or password is missing; 401 for invalid credentials; 500 for a server error. Use Login or Register before calling protected endpoints.

Returns the authenticated user's public account details.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Obtain a token from Login or Register.
Headers: Bearer authorization; no request body.
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, user: { id, name, email, createdAt } }`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 404 if the user no longer exists; 500 for a server error.

Returns the authenticated user's stored health profile; a new user may receive an empty profile object.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ success: true, profile: { ... } }`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 404 if the user does not exist; 500 for a server error.

Creates or replaces the authenticated user's profile object.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: Required truthy fields are `gender`, `age`, `height`, `weight`, `bloodGroup`, `periodRegularity`, `cycleLength`, and `menstrualFlow`. `gender`, when provided, must be `Female`, `Male`, or `Other`; `age`, `height`, `weight`, `cycleLength`, and `sleepDuration` cannot be negative. Optional `dob`, if supplied, must not be in the future.
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, message, profile: { ...submitted fields } }`.
Errors: 400 for missing required fields or validation failure; 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 404 if user is not found; 500 for a server error.

Runs a PCOS prediction through the AI service; this route does not save an assessment.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: A `features` object keyed by the PCOS model feature names (for example the keys shown here).
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, disease: "pcos", result: { disease, prediction, label, probability, probabilityPositive, riskLevel, riskLabel, featuresUsed } }`.
Errors: 400 if `features` is missing or invalid downstream; 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 502 if the AI service rejects or cannot complete the prediction.

Runs a diabetes risk prediction through the AI service; this route does not save an assessment.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: A `features` object keyed by the diabetes model feature names (for example the keys shown here).
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, disease: "diabetes", result: { disease, prediction, label, probability, probabilityPositive, riskLevel, riskLabel, featuresUsed } }`.
Errors: 400 if `features` is missing or invalid downstream; 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 502 if the AI service rejects or cannot complete the prediction.

Runs a thyroid prediction through the AI service; this route does not save an assessment.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: A `features` object keyed by the thyroid model feature names (for example the keys shown here).
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, disease: "thyroid", result: { disease, prediction, label, probability, probabilityPositive, riskLevel, riskLabel, featuresUsed } }`.
Errors: 400 if `features` is missing or invalid downstream; 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 502 if the AI service rejects or cannot complete the prediction.

Runs PCOS, diabetes, and thyroid predictions in parallel and stores the combined assessment for the authenticated user. The backend defaults omitted model objects to empty objects.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: Optional objects `pcos`, `diabetes`, and `thyroid`, each containing keys for its corresponding model.
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (201): `{ success: true, message, assessment: { id, userId, results: { pcos, diabetes, thyroid }, createdAt } }`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 502 if any AI prediction fails.

Returns the most recent saved full assessment for the authenticated user. Run a full assessment first to create one.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ success: true, assessment: { id, userId, results, createdAt } }`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 404 if no assessment exists; 500 for a server error.

Returns up to the 10 most recently created saved assessments for the authenticated user.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ success: true, assessments: [{ id, userId, results, createdAt }] }`; an empty history is `assessments: []`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 500 for a server error.

Uploads a blood report file, extracts supported laboratory values from PDFs, generates a summary, and stores the report record.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Content type: `multipart/form-data`; let Postman set the boundary. Required form-data file field: `file`. Accepted files: PDF, JPG/JPEG, or PNG; maximum size is 10 MB.
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (201): `{ success: true, message, bloodReport: { id, userId, originalFileName, filePath, uploadedAt, extractedResults, aiSummary } }`. Scanned image content is not extracted by the current controller; image uploads still create a record.
Errors: 400 if file is missing or unsupported; 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 413 if file is over 10 MB; 500 if processing or persistence fails.

Lists blood report records belonging to the authenticated user, newest first. Upload a report first to populate the list.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ success: true, bloodReports: [{ id, userId, originalFileName, filePath, uploadedAt, extractedResults, aiSummary }] }`; an empty list is `bloodReports: []`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 500 for a server error.

variable.description: Report ID returned by upload or list

request.description:
Returns one blood report belonging to the authenticated user. Set `id` to a report ID returned by Upload or List blood reports.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
URL parameter: `id` (required).
Query/body: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, bloodReport: { id, userId, originalFileName, filePath, uploadedAt, extractedResults, aiSummary } }`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 404 if the report is not found for this user; 500 for a server error.

Creates a journal entry and adds an automated general-information insight.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: Required `date` in `YYYY-MM-DD` format; optional `symptoms` array of strings (non-string/blank entries are dropped and at most 20 are retained); optional `notes` string up to 5000 characters (defaults to an empty string).
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (201): `{ success: true, message, entry: { id, userId, date, symptoms, notes, automatedInsight, createdAt } }`.
Errors: 400 for invalid/missing date or invalid/overlong notes; 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 500 for a server error.

Lists journal entries belonging to the authenticated user. Create an entry first to populate the list.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ success: true, entries: [{ id, userId, date, symptoms, notes, automatedInsight, createdAt }] }`; an empty list is `entries: []`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 500 for a server error.

variable.description: Journal entry ID returned by create or list

request.description:
Returns one journal entry belonging to the authenticated user. Set `id` to an entry ID returned by Create or List journal entries.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
URL parameter: `id` (required).
Query/body: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, entry: { id, userId, date, symptoms, notes, automatedInsight, createdAt } }`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 404 if the entry is not found for this user; 500 for a server error.

Sends a health-information question to the assistant and attempts to save the exchange in the user's chat history.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`.
Body: Required non-empty string `message`.
Query/URL parameters: None.
Success (200): `{ success: true, reply: "..." }`.
Errors: 400 if message is missing, not a string, or blank; 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 500 if the assistant service is not configured; 502 if the assistant provider fails or returns an empty response. A chat persistence failure is logged but does not fail an otherwise successful reply.

Returns persisted assistant messages for the authenticated user. Send an assistant message first to create history.

Authentication: Required; `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from Login or Register.
Input: None; no query or URL parameters.
Success (200): `{ success: true, messages: [{ role, content, createdAt }] }`; no history returns `messages: []`.
Errors: 401 for missing, invalid, or expired JWT; 500 if chat history cannot be loaded.
